title: 安全な読取・検証commandだけを狭いprefix ruleで事前許可し(Claude Code `permissions.allow`、Codex `prefix_rule`+`approval_policy="on-request"`+`sandbox_mode="workspace-write"`)、危険操作はdeny/askに残してpermission fatigueを減らす。

problem_titles.G17: 安全な読取操作にも毎回承認が必要でPermission fatigueになる

risk_reasons: R3 operation markers: permissions?\.(allow|deny), approval_policy, permission fatigue, 事前許可
why_not_autonomous: R3 operation or structural decision: R3 operation markers: permissions?\.(allow|deny), approval_policy, permission fatigue, 事前許可; R2 operation markers: sandbox
alternatives_considered: owning shared Plugin from remedy_routes: none
new shared Skill/Plugin: not selected (no new_asset_justification; last resort)
setting/harness remedy without owner → consumer configuration guidance (authority records, consumers apply as project change)
existing_capabilities: Claude Code built-in `/fewer-permission-prompts` (proposes a prioritized read-only allowlist from transcripts)
options: A: per consumer, run /fewer-permission-prompts, keep deny/ask for write/network/destructive prefixes, commit .claude/settings.json under human review
B: keep prompting as is (accept fatigue)
C: shared allowlist template in a Plugin (rejected: allowlists are repository/permission-specific and R3 by policy)
evaluation_plan: permission prompts per session on a fixed replay of read-only tasks before/after; guardrail: zero newly allowed write/network/destructive prefixes

evidence.summary: 読取toolとbuilt-in read-only Bash(ls,cat,grep,find,git read-only等)は既定でprompt無し。`Bash(npm run test *)`等のprefix wildcard、`:*`接尾、`timeout`等wrapper除去。deny > ask > allowの優先。permission modes: default(manual)/acceptEdits/plan/auto/dontAsk/bypassPermissions。argument制約patternは脆弱と警告
PreToolUse hookは`hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision`= allow|deny|ask を返せる(rule表現力を超える判定に使える)
`~/.codex/rules/default.rules`または信頼済み`<repo>/.codex/rules/`に`prefix_rule(pattern=[...], decision="allow|prompt|forbidden")`。複数一致時は最も制限的な判定。Smart approvalsがescalation時にprefix_ruleを提案
risk-based approval: low-riskまで毎回確認すると形骸化・approval fatigue。high-impact actionだけ承認に残す
